corpus.display_and_cross_check: Tanzil Quran Text, Uthmani script, corpus/quran-uthmani.txt, SHA-256 ac0724796cbbda0f4801470fbbd11d0f3c5802067bae0493466d0128b0c667af, 1,334,737 bytes, 6,236 verses, 77,881 whitespace tokens. Used only for display Arabic (copied byte-for-byte) and for a raw stem cross-check (tanzil_raw_count).

methodology.name_list_source: Standard 99-name Tirmidhi enumeration (Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3507), as tabulated at openarabic.org/99-names-of-allah/ and cross-checked against asmaulhusna.com and getlivingquran.com. Caveat: the hadith affirms 99 Names, but the enumeration itself is a weaker narration; some compilations count Allah itself as first. Two duplicate-transliteration pairs exist in the list: 48 Al-Majid (al-majiyd) vs 65 Al-Majid (al-maajid, rendered 'Al-Maajid' here), and 55 Al-Waliyy (al-waliyy) vs 77 Al-Wali (al-waalii, defective form wal).
counting_rules: Primary count = QAC segments whose LEM: is the Name's lemma and whose referent is God. A word counts only when it is predicated of God (or in apposition to Allah / huwa / rabb), NOT when the same lemma describes a human, angel, prophet, the Book/Quran, the Throne, provisions, rewards, places, or abstract nouns (justice, truth as a concept, sovereignty, light as guidance).

Where a lemma is ambiguous, the script uses an explicit whitelist or blacklist of verse references (see each Name's notes and excluded_refs), decided by reading every occurrence of that lemma in context.

Plural forms sharing the Name's lemma are counted when divine (e.g. al-khaliqun 56:59, al-warithun 15:23, muntaqimun 32:22/43:41/44:16, al-mujibun 37:75, al-qadirun 77:23) and excluded when human (e.g. al-tawwabin 2:222, al-muqsiTin 5:42/49:9/60:8).

Related-form lemmas (a different lemma of the same attribute, e.g. Ealim al-ghayb for Al-Alim, ghafir a*-*anb for Al-Ghafur, arHam ar-raHimin, khayr ar-raziqin, allahu >akobar) are reported separately as related_forms and are NOT in the primary count — except where the Name never occurs in its exact lemma and only a variant/plural form is attested (qadir, muHyi, had, mutaEal, wal, muntaqimun plural, wari*un plural), where the counted variant LEM: is listed explicitly in qac_lemmas.

QAC counts exclude the 113 surah-initial basmalahs (they are not numbered verses except 1:1). The basmalah at 1:1 and the inline basmalah at 27:30 ARE in QAC; basmalah_count records how many of a Name's occurrences are basmalahs (Rahman 2, Rahim 2). Tanzil text has 112 further basmalahs, so the Tanzil totals are Rahman 57+112=169 and Rahim 115+112=227.

Phrase vs standalone: an occurrence is 'phrase' when another counted Name occurs in the same verse within word distance <= 2 (covers ar-Rahman ar-Rahim, Eaziz Hakim, ghafur raHim, samiE Ealim, and the 59:22-24 sequence); otherwise 'standalone'.

Display Arabic: the exact Uthmani token from the Tanzil corpus at the same surah:verse, copied byte-for-byte, never retyped. For Names with count 0, the conventional vowelled form from the name-list source is used.

Tanzil cross-check (tanzil_raw_count): raw count of tokens whose normalised stem matches the Name, over the whole Tanzil text including basmalahs. It is deliberately un-disambiguated — it over-counts homonyms (Eali 'high' vs the preposition EalaY, aHad 'anyone', Haqq 'truth') and under/over-counts where the Name's form is defective or plural. It is a sanity check only; the QAC count is the reported count.
methodology.ayah_table_correction: The brief's ayah-count table listed surahs 5 and 6 as 165, 120; the correct order is 120 (Al-Ma'idah) then 165 (Al-An'am). The sum is 6236 either way, but the order matters for verse references; the table in this script is corrected.
methodology.qac_vs_tanzil: QAC has 77,429 segmented words; Tanzil has 77,881 whitespace tokens. Difference 452 = 448 (112 surah-initial basmalahs x 4 words, present in Tanzil but not numbered in QAC) + 4 verses where QAC merges two Tanzil tokens into one word: 2:181, 8:6, 13:37, 37:130. Only 4 of 6,236 verses differ in word count.
methodology.script: data/names_script.py — run with `python3 names_script.py` from the data/ directory. It re-parses both corpora, re-counts, and asserts every Name's count equals the verified expected count and every related-form count reconciles with the corpus lemma total; it exits non-zero on any mismatch.
